STORYTIME ADVENTURE 30 · CLASS 29

Storybook Castle Challenge

Age 4–5 YearsClass 29 · StorytimeSkill The grand story challenge

Three story challenges guard the castle: order the story, read the feeling, pick what happens next.

Play the story game ↓Print the worksheet ↓Play with a finger, a stylus or a mouse. Instructions are spoken aloud.
PLAY · THE GRAND STORY CHALLENGE

Storybook Castle Challenge

Three story challenges! What happens first, how does the character feel, and what happens next?

Challenge one: WHAT HAPPENS FIRST?

Challenge two: the rabbit gets a gift. HOW DOES THE CHARACTER FEEL?

Challenge three: Fox stands in the rain with an umbrella. WHAT HAPPENS NEXT?

Castle unlocked!

Seeds come first, gifts bring joy, and the umbrella opens before the walk.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

A gentle finale that mixes three story skills: sequencing, feelings, and prediction. Celebrate each shield earned — three in a row unlocks the castle!

Prefer paper? The Storybook Castle Challenge worksheet prints the same story with room to retell and draw — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
